description: Business associate contracts do not require subcontractors to implement same safeguards.
applicability: This signal applies to: Covered entities and business associates Healthcare organizations with business associate relationships Group health plans and plan sponsors Organizations requiring HIPAA compliance documentation Vendor management and contract administration functions

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Review Business Associate Agreements to verify they include provisions requiring subcontractors to comply with the same safeguards. Examine contract templates and executed agreements for subcontractor flow-down clauses. Assess whether business associates have processes to ensure subcontractors execute appropriate agreements before handling ePHI.
